    Profile

    Forcas is a "Killer Princess" of the Church of Ragnarok who was guided to this world from the continent of Ragna. She shares her name with her Killium weapon. She's a hardworking and honest girl, and prefers to let actions speak louder than words. Given that her Killium comes from a demonic weapon, it's no surprise that she possesses awesome destructive power.

    Origin: Ragna
    Gender: Female
    Height: 162cm
    Weight: 47kg
    Birthday: Jan 31
    Blood Type: Type A
    Zodiac: Aquarius
    Likes: Fortunetelling, healing crystals
    Hobbies: Horse-riding, thinking to herself
    Illust: しぶ彦
    CV: 清都ありさ
